newsitem.title: CANADA: Aurex receives option to buy rest of mine.
newsitem.headline: Aurex receives option to buy rest of mine.

text.p: Aurex Resources Corp said Tuesday it has received an offer to buy the 60 percent of the San Esteban gold and copper mine in Chile that it does not already own.
The Chilean family that owns the 60 percent has signed a deal with Aurex that would give the company the option to buy the rest of the property for US$3.35 million, Aurex said.
The offer requires payment of US$350,000 upon exercise of the option and US$3 million upon acquisition of the shares on May 15, 1997.
Acceptance of the deal requires Aurex board approval, Aurex said.
Aurex currently owns 40 percent of the mine, which produces about 24,000 ounces of gold and seven million pounds of copper a year.
The proven and probable reserves contain 128,000 ounces of gold and 44 million pounds of copper.
Should Aurex opt to buy the rest of the mine, the company said it will implement an aggressive drilling program to justify an expansion.
